title: Add Teaser to Presentation Media
description: Add a new feature to images, iframes, video, etc: teaser. Optionally a label can be provided to a teaser. When teaser is active then the element is glassy. e.g. on iframe wrap it into a another div with a glassy div infront of it.
summary: Added optional `teaser` to figure, video, pdf, and iframe embodiments. When set, media renders inside a `MediaTeaserWrap` with a frosted glass veil overlay and optional label. CSS uses backdrop-filter blur/saturate. Tests cover `mediaTeaserActive` and teaser rendering for figure, video, and iframe.
